name: Gilman Electric Supply
old_description: An account at Gilman gains you access to Square D's Special Pricing Agreement so you can get the best switchgear for the best price.
about:
Gilman Electric Supply operates from a single location at 128-B Center Street in Auburn, Maine, positioning itself as Androscoggin County's electrical supplier of choice. The company is a member of the CED Family of Distributors, a national network that extends its reach beyond the local market. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The business distributes a broad range of electrical materials including pipe and wire, Square D switchgear, lighting fixtures, and Generac generator systems with integrated transfer switches. It offers next-day delivery on many stocked items through UPS Red Label shipping, and provides an online customer portal for ordering, quote requests, QuickBooks integration, and electronic payments. The facility maintains regular weekday hours and emphasizes detail-oriented package assembly for contractors.

Primary customers are electrical contractors and construction firms bidding on commercial, industrial, and residential projects. Gilman supports these clients with access to spec sheets, commodity pricing on pipe and wire, and value-engineered lighting packages designed to help win bids. The CED affiliation also grants access to hard-to-find items and manufacturer special pricing agreements.

Gilman states its mission is to remain detail oriented and cost effective while scaling local expertise through national capabilities. The company highlights its Square D Special Pricing Agreement and the CED network as key advantages that reduce lead times and expand product availability.

name: Glacial Wood Products Inc
old_description: Everything we do is made-to-order. We manufacture world class wood components, so you can blow your clients away.
about:
Glacial Wood Products Inc was founded in 1991 in Brooten, Minnesota. The company is owned by Dan Soldner and operates with a team of skilled craftsmen that includes specialists in lathing, milling, CNC machining, drafting, and customer service.

The shop produces made-to-order wood components such as legs, posts, balusters, stair treads, newel posts, and custom square or turned parts. It also offers historical wood replication and custom woodwork from rough sketches. All drafting, machining, sanding, and inspection are performed in-house using CNC machinery, lathes, and milling equipment.

Glacial Wood serves cabinet makers, stair makers, furniture makers, interior designers, builders, architects, and other custom wood manufacturers. Named customers include Medalcraft Mint, Lake Shore Stair Company, and Greenfield Cabinetry.

The company emphasizes that it does not cut corners because its customers do not either. Its stated mission is to enhance the lives of its team and customers by delivering products that set the standard for craftsmanship, with no middlemen and no shortcuts between drafting and delivery.

name: Global Cable and Wire Corp.
about:
Global Cable and Wire Corp. operates from Great Neck, New York, supplying electrical wire and cable to contractors and homeowners across the United States. The company maintains a stocked inventory of underground secondary distribution cables, including aluminum triplex URD direct-burial assemblies in sizes ranging from 6 AWG to 2/0 AWG.

Its product line centers on twisted aluminum alloy conductors for direct-burial service, marketed under the Global Cable & Wire brand. The catalog also includes a growing data-center cable category. Orders of $500 or more ship free, and most stocked items leave the warehouse the same day or within two business days. A 30-day return policy and price-matching guarantee back each sale.

Customers include electrical contractors bidding residential, commercial, and utility projects, as well as data-center operators and individual homeowners. The company positions itself as a rapid-response supplier for jobs of any scale, from quick pickups to large-scale bulk orders.

Global Cable and Wire emphasizes reliable, on-time delivery and expert technical support—available by chat, email, or phone—to keep projects on schedule. The offering is built around UL 854-listed service-entrance cables and a commitment to reducing waste by reusing packaging materials.

name: Global Circuit Innovations
old_description: “Global Circuit Innovations provided a form, fit and function solution to keep our Black Hawk helicopters flying.”
about:
Global Circuit Innovations, Inc. (GCI) is based in Colorado Springs, Colorado. The company specializes in electronic systems solutions for aerospace and defense platforms.

GCI develops electronic obsolescence solutions for legacy systems, drawing on decades of digital and analog circuitry experience. The company engineers circuit card assemblies for applications such as the DSM-157 test box used in Maverick missile testing, and provides environmental hardening for demanding conditions. Its hermetic product line delivers sealed electronic packages for high-reliability environments. Capabilities span electronic systems solutions, harsh-environment electronics, and research and development.

The company serves military aviation and missile programs. References include a form-fit-function replacement that kept Sikorsky Black Hawk helicopters operational, and obsolescence solutions for the U.S. Air Force F-16 fleet that are credited with saving tens of millions of dollars. Work also extends to Maverick missile test equipment.

GCI emphasizes cost-effective, proven obsolescence management and device-physics expertise for environmental hardening. The firm holds intellectual property and publishes technical papers supporting its approach to sustaining critical electronic systems.

name: Global Food Services, Inc
old_description: Food Service That Prioritizes Quality, Consistency, and Guest Satisfaction
about:
Global Food Services, Inc. operates from Tampa, Florida, where it runs a food manufacturing and co-packing facility. The company supplies restaurants and other foodservice channels with a focus on healthy, vegetarian items such as dips, sauces, and spices.

Its product portfolio includes the Kasabah line of Mediterranean foods — hummus, falafel, tzatziki, tabouli, and a gluten-free buttermilk pancake mix built on chickpea protein. Beyond its own brand, the company provides co-packing and contract manufacturing for restaurant chains, developing recipes from scratch or reverse-engineering existing menu items, then producing and distributing the finished goods through its own distribution network.

Customers span restaurants, retail outlets, private-label programs, educational institutions, and grocery distributors. The operation is structured to handle everything from recipe formulation to bulk production and delivery, allowing clients to centralize their supply chain.

The company emphasizes an FDA-licensed facility, strict quality-control guidelines, and NDA-protected confidentiality for proprietary recipes. It also promotes bulk purchasing advantages and seamless distribution as ways to reduce costs and maintain consistent flavor across locations.

about:
Global Gear Group, LLC operates from Norman, Oklahoma. The company traces its roots to Cherokee Cap Creations, Inc., and has spent over 25 years serving the promotional advertising industry with custom ball caps and related products. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The firm functions as a promotional product distributor, offering access to more than 900,000 items sourced from over 3,000 suppliers. In-house capabilities include embroidery and silkscreen decoration, graphic design support, and the ability to fulfill expedited orders. The company also provides free samples to prospective clients.

Global Gear Group serves businesses across virtually every sector that use promotional merchandise for marketing, including corporate buyers, advertising agencies, and organizations seeking branded wearables and ad specialty items. Its customer base spans companies worldwide.

The company emphasizes a combination of low pricing, immediate accessibility, and in-house graphic support as its primary differentiators. Its stated mission is to help clients build long-lasting relationships through promotional products.

name: Global One Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Since its inception in 2015, Global One has established a reputation of providing welding services with quick turnaround times and attention to detail.
about:
Global One Manufacturing Inc was established in 2015 in Cascade, Iowa, a small community on US Highway 151 between Cedar Rapids and Dubuque. The business was launched by three investors who revived a local welding shop after the previous owner of Cascade Custom Manufacturing retired in the early 2000s, leaving area businesses, farmers, and entrepreneurs without a nearby fabrication resource.

The company provides welding, custom fabrication, steel fabrication, and painting services. Its product lineup includes trailers, railings, floor grates, farm implements, and packing‑house trolley assemblies. Global One also sells steel stock and offers custom design work to match customer specifications. The shop’s team carries over 20 years of combined welding experience, led by shop manager Jarrod Burns, who has spent two decades advancing from apprentice to expert welder.

Customers come from agriculture, food‑processing, transportation, and general industrial sectors. Local farmers order custom farm implements; packing houses rely on the company for trolley‑assembly fabrication; and industrial clients request trailers, railings, and floor grates. The firm also serves entrepreneurs and small businesses needing one‑off steel fabrications.

Global One emphasizes quick turnaround times and attention to detail as its primary differentiators. The founders restarted the shop to restore a missing local capability, and the company promotes its ability to “try anything” when it comes to fabrication and making new parts, positioning itself as a flexible, heartland‑based manufacturing partner.

name: Globe Food Equipment Co.
old_description: Learn how the reimagined slicers empower you to prep without limits
about:
Globe Food Equipment Company is based in Moraine, Ohio, and has spent decades building a reputation around commercial slicers and food-preparation equipment. The company's history emphasizes reliable, high-performance slicers as its founding cornerstone, though a specific founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The manufacturer produces a broad line of commercial foodservice equipment including premium slicers (such as the redesigned S-Series), spiral and planetary mixers, scales, meat choppers, vacuum packaging chambers, cheese shredders, griddles, charbroilers, sandwich grills, electric fryers, immersion circulators (model GSV18), and immersion blenders. The product range is supported by a two-year parts-and-labor warranty, though facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Globe serves the commercial foodservice sector—restaurants, institutional kitchens, and catering operations—through a network of dealers and service technicians. The company also operates a “Try Before You Buy” program that connects buyers with affiliated representative chefs and test kitchens for hands-on demonstrations.

Globe positions itself on lasting value and personal service, highlighting continuous design improvements aimed at reducing service costs, a strong dealer-support network, and a commitment to on-time delivery and competitive pricing.

name: Go Solar Power
old_description: Power your home with clean, renewable energy and lower your electric bills. Our expert team designs and installs custom solar solutions for maximum efficiency and savings.
about:
Go Solar Power operates from Birmingham, Alabama, providing solar energy solutions for homes and businesses. The company functions as a Service Experts company backed by Brookfield Infrastructure, a global infrastructure investor with approximately $20 billion in assets. No founding year or individual founders are disclosed in public materials.

The firm delivers consulting, engineering, project management, and installation services for residential and commercial photovoltaic systems, including battery energy storage such as Tesla Powerwall units. After activation, it monitors system performance and provides ongoing maintenance, inspections, and repairs through a national service network. The company also manages permitting and homeowners-association approvals on behalf of customers.

Customers include homeowners, commercial property owners, and multi-family housing developers such as apartment complexes. Reviews reference real estate agents seeking guidance for clients, as well as direct residential buyers. The company positions its offerings across residential solar, commercial solar, and battery storage segments.

Go Solar Power emphasizes a “Peace of Mind Service” model that combines billion-dollar infrastructure backing with local service accountability. It advertises zero-upfront-cost options, competitive pricing with no hidden fees, and an Energy Easement Program (EEP) designed to lower energy costs and support ESG goals for businesses.
